import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timezone from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string, redirect, url_for, flash from itsdangerous import URLSafeTimedSerializer app = Flask(__name__) app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'wiki-secret-key-change-in-production' # Initialize SQLite database def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3') cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, last_modified_by TEXT NOT NULL, last_modified_at TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, contributor TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT, edited_at TEXT NOT NULL, old_content TEXT, new_content TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) ) ''') conn.commit() conn.close() init_db() # Helper to generate unique IDs import uuid from hashlib import sha256 def generate_entry_id(title, created_by): unique_string = f"{title}:{created_by}:{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}" return sha256(unique_string.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] # HTML templates BASE_HTML = ''' {% block title %}Wiki{% endblock %}

Wiki

Entries
{% with messages = get_flashed_messages() %} {% if messages %}
{% for message in messages %}

{{ message }}

{% endfor %}
{% endif %} {% endwith %} {% block content %}{% endblock %}
''' ENTRY_HTML = '''{% extends "base.html" %} {% block title %}{{ entry.title }}{% endblock %} {% block content %}

{{ entry.title }}

Last modified: {{ entry.lastModifiedAt }} by {{ entry.lastModifiedBy }}
{{ entry.content|safe }}
{% if entry.id %}

Edit History

View edit history {% endif %}
{% endblock %} ''' EDITS_HTML = '''{% extends "base.html" %} {% block title %}{{ entry.title }} - Edit History{% endblock %} {% block content %}

{{ entry.title }} - Edit History

{% if edits %}
    {% for edit in edits %}
  1. {{ edit.contributor }} on {{ edit.editedAt }} {% if edit.summary %}
    Summary: {{ edit.summary }}{% endif %}
    Old: {{ edit.oldContent|escape }} New: {{ edit.newContent|escape }}
    2. {% endfor %}
{% else %}

No edits found for this entry.

{% endif %}
Back to entry
{% endblock %} ''' NEW_ENTRY_HTML = '''{% extends "base.html" %} {% block title %}Create New Entry{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Create New Entry


Cancel - view entries {% endblock %} ''' EDIT_ENTRY_HTML = '''{% extends "base.html" %} {% block title %}Edit Entry{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Edit Entry


Cancel - view entries {% endblock %} ''' def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3') conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn @app.route('/') def index(): return redirect(url_for('list_entries')) @app.route('/entries', methods=['GET']) def list_entries(): conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute('SELECT id, title, last_modified_by, last_modified_at FROM entries ORDER BY last_modified_at DESC') entries = cursor.fetchall() conn.close() entry_links = [] for entry in entries: entry_links.append({ 'id': entry['id'], 'title': entry['title'], 'link': url_for('entry_detail', entryId=entry['id']) }) return render_template_string(BASE_HTML + '''

All Entries

    {% for entry in entry_links %}
  • {{ entry.title }} (ID: {{ entry.id }})
    • {% endfor %}

Create new entry

''', entry_links=entry_links) @app.route('/entries/', methods=['GET']) def entry_detail(entryId): conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entryId,)) entry = cursor.fetchone() conn.close() if entry is None: flash('Entry not found') return redirect(url_for('list_entries')) return render_template_string(BASE_HTML + ENTRY_HTML, entry=dict(entry)) @app.route('/entries', methods=['POST']) def create_entry(): data = request.get_json() if not data: # If no JSON, try form data title = request.form.get('title', '') content = request.form.get('content', '') created_by = request.form.get('createdBy', '') else: title = data.get('title', '') content = data.get('content', '') created_by = data.get('createdBy', '') if not title or not content or not created_by: flash('Title, content, and createdBy are required') return redirect(url_for('list_entries')) entry_id = generate_entry_id(title, created_by) now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() # Create or update entry cursor.execute(''' INSERT OR REPLACE INTO entries (id, title, content, created_by, last_modified_by, last_modified_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ''', (entry_id, title, content, created_by, created_by, now)) # Record this as an edit cursor.execute(''' INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, edited_at, old_content, new_content) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ''', (entry_id, created_by, 'Initial creation', now, None, content)) conn.commit() conn.close() # Return Entry schema response entry_data = { 'id': entry_id, 'title': title, 'content': content, 'lastModifiedBy': created_by, 'lastModifiedAt': now } return entry_data, 201 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['PUT']) def update_entry(entryId): data = request.get_json() if not data: flash('JSON data required') return redirect(url_for('list_entries')) content = data.get('content', '') modified_by = data.get('modifiedBy', '') summary = data.get('summary', '') if not content or not modified_by or not summary: flash('Content, modifiedBy, and summary are required') return redirect(url_for('entry_detail', entryId=entryId)) conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() # Check if entry exists cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entryId,)) existing = cursor.fetchone() if existing is None: conn.close() flash('Entry not found') return redirect(url_for('list_entries')) now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() old_content = existing['content'] # Update entry cursor.execute(''' UPDATE entries SET content = ?, last_modified_by = ?, last_modified_at = ? WHERE id = ? ''', (content, modified_by, now, entryId)) # Record this as an edit cursor.execute(''' INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, edited_at, old_content, new_content) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ''', (entryId, modified_by, summary, now, old_content, content)) conn.commit() conn.close() # Return Entry schema response entry_data = { 'id': entryId, 'title': existing['title'], 'content': content, 'lastModifiedBy': modified_by, 'lastModifiedAt': now } return entry_data, 200 @app.route('/entries//edits', methods=['GET']) def entry_edits(entryId): conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' SELECT contributor, summary, edited_at, old_content, new_content FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ? ORDER BY edited_at DESC ''', (entryId,)) edits = cursor.fetchall() conn.close() if not edits: flash('Entry not found or no edits') return redirect(url_for('entry_detail', entryId=entryId)) edit_list = [] for edit in edits: edit_list.append({ 'contributor': edit[0], 'summary': edit[1], 'editedAt': edit[2], 'oldContent': edit[3] or '', 'newContent': edit[4] or '' }) # Get entry title conn2 = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3') cursor2 = conn2.cursor() cursor2.execute('SELECT title FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entryId,)) entry = cursor2.fetchone() conn2.close() entry_title = entry['title'] if entry else 'Unknown' return render_template_string(BASE_HTML + EDITES_HTML, entry={'title': entry_title, 'id': entryId}, edits=edit_list) if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=True)
